title: Zanetti or Facchetti: Inter's greatest ever? THE DEBATE No. 8
caption:
Zanetti or Facchetti — who is Inter's greatest ever?
Giacinto Facchetti: 634 games, 75 goals from left-back, 2 European Cups (1964, 1965), 4 Scudetti, Ballon d'Or runner-up in 1965.
Javier Zanetti: 858 games (the club record), 16 trophies, 5 Scudetti, captain of the 2010 treble.
We picked. Who's yours?
